channel.title: Financialist News
channel.description: Daily money news from Financialist: debt relief, consumer rights, insurance, banking and your money.

item.title: Florida Clears Four Home Insurance Rate Cuts. Will Your Renewal Be Cheaper?
item.description: Florida says four approved insurer rate decreases affect more than 62,000 policies. The cuts take effect at renewal and do not guarantee a lower bill for every homeowner.
item.author: James Park

item.title: New York Wants to Shut Polymarket Down: What the Lawsuit Actually Says
item.description: New York sued Polymarket, alleging unlicensed gambling and seeking a shutdown, penalties and restitution. The allegations are contested, not a court ruling or an approved refund.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Colorado Health Premiums Rise 10% for 2027, but Subsidized Bills Tell Another Story
item.description: Colorado approved an average 10% individual-market premium rise for 2027. State assistance may limit the average net increase for aided shoppers; your bill depends on plan and eligibility.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Amazon Prime Refunds Expand to $200; More Checks Start October 1
item.description: A revised FTC-Amazon order raises the Prime refund cap to $200 and adds automatic payments starting October 1, 2026. Who may be included and how to avoid refund scams.
item.author: David Chen

item.title: Bought a Generic Drug Years Ago? Check This $96 Million Settlement Before March 8
item.description: A multistate generic-drug settlement has a March 8, 2027 claim deadline. Check the covered drugs, 2009-2019 purchase window and eligibility before filing.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Paid a Surprise Maryland Hospital Fee? Some UMMS Patients Are Getting Refunds
item.description: A Maryland settlement will return $2.25 million in outpatient facility fees to eligible UMMS patients. Who qualifies, when checks are expected and what the state says.
item.author: David Chen

item.title: FTC weighs new duties for platforms carrying impersonation ads
item.description: Agency seeks evidence about ad tools and impersonation scams. No new platform rule has taken effect.
item.author: David Chen

item.title: September 28 tax deadline approaches for eligible San Carlos Apache Tribe disaster area taxpayers
item.description: Eligible taxpayers in the San Carlos Apache Tribe disaster area have a September 28 deadline for many postponed filings and payments.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Hawaii joins proposed Credit Acceptance auto-loan settlement with debt relief
item.description: Proposed multistate settlement offers potential cash restitution and debt relief for eligible Credit Acceptance borrowers.
item.author: James Park

item.title: States reach $2.3 million Labcorp settlement over debt collector's data breach
item.description: Forty-four states reached an agreement with Labcorp over patient data held by a medical debt collector.
item.author: David Chen

item.title: Nano Banc deposits transfer to Sunwest after California closure
item.description: What customers can use this weekend and when the only branch reopens.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Maryland approves 2027 ACA rates: 14.6% average increase before subsidies
item.description: Regulator figures show why a market average and a household bill differ.
item.author: David Chen

item.title: IRS adds account notices and tax records to free mobile app
item.description: Official app adds selected account features; watch for tax-account lookalikes.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Michigan attorney general challenges UPPCO electric rate hike
item.description: A proposed 15.6% residential increase is not approved; state advocates a smaller increase.
item.author: James Park

item.title: Michigan sues generator sellers over customer deposits
item.description: State alleges customers paid deposits but did not receive generators or refunds.

item.title: New York warns of storm price gouging: what to document
